reviews.text: I have enlarged pores on my nose, so I started using this product. After using it for a while, I feel like my pores have become less visible and my skin looks smoother！
reviews.zh: 我個鼻毛孔粗大，所以開始用呢個產品。用咗一段時間之後，覺得毛孔冇之前咁明顯，皮膚睇落都滑咗！

reviews.text: I have used this for a few weeks and definitely feel that this keeps my pores clean! No irritation for me, I use with the ilso deep clean oil cleanser and have loved the results and clean feeling without feeling dry
reviews.zh: 用咗幾個禮拜，確實覺得佢幫到我清乾淨毛孔！我用完冇刺激感，配合 ilso deep clean oil cleanser 一齊用，效果同清爽感都好好，又唔會覺得乾。

reviews.text: I feel like this breaks me out. Maybe it’s too aggressive since I do have pretty sensitive skin and I do not see much pore tightening benefits. maybe it works better for other people.
reviews.zh: 我覺得呢個會令我爆瘡。可能係太強勁，因為我皮膚幾敏感，又睇唔到有咩收毛孔效果。可能其他人用會好啲。

reviews.text: This stuff works wonders paired with their other nose serum (can’t remember the name. But they help clear my nose of blackheads and they also reappear much slower too.
reviews.zh: 呢個嘢同佢哋另一支鼻用精華一齊用效果神奇（記唔嗰個名）。佢哋幫我清走咗鼻上嘅黑頭，而且黑頭再生嘅速度都慢咗好多。

reviews.text: Nice serum but not entirely sure it does anything for pore tightening. I use it every night so will keep seeing if it works and will update my review. It absorbs quickly and there is no irritation though which is nice.
reviews.zh: 係一支唔錯嘅精華，但唔係好肯定佢對收毛孔有冇幫助。我每晚都用，會繼續留意有冇效，再更新評價。不過佢吸收得快，又冇刺激感，呢樣幾好。

reviews.text: I won’t say it tight the pore completely but it really helped my skin felt smooth!! I have irritated redness and dry peels that has hard impact on my life, but ever since I used it, my skin felt much smoother I don’t get rashes that often, no peeling skin anymore, really recommend it
reviews.zh: 我唔會話佢可以完全收毛孔，但佢真係幫到我塊面感覺滑咗好多！！我之前有受刺激泛紅同甩皮嘅問題，對我生活影響好大，但自從用咗之後，皮膚感覺滑咗好多，唔係成日出紅疹，唔再甩皮，真心推介。

reviews.text: It works similarly as the nose patch (step 2). Except this bottled version enables me to apply it on other specific areas other than the nose. I used this after applying the melting sebumbto close the pores. Love it!
reviews.zh: 效果同鼻貼（step 2）差唔多。只不過呢支裝嘅好處係可以塗喺鼻以外其他特定部位。我會喺用完 melting sebumb 之後再用佢收毛孔。好鍾意！

reviews.text: I love this product so much. It's lightweight and feels clean. It doesn't have fragrance like other pesky products do and it makes my skin feel cool and look glowing. It didn't help my pores as much, but that's just my genetics unfortunately. Will be buying again immediately.
reviews.zh: 我超鍾意呢個產品。質地輕盈，感覺清爽。佢冇其他煩人產品嗰啲香味，而且用完皮膚感覺涼浸浸，望落有光澤。佢對收毛孔幫助唔係好大，但遺憾地呢個係我基因嘅問題。會即刻再回購。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
